|game_text=Deploy on your [[Death Star II: Throne Room{{!}}Throne Room]]. While Emperor and Vader here, [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Take Your Father's Place]] does not deplete Life Force or cause Force loss. Once per turn, may deploy a docking bay or [[So Be It, Jedi]] from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. 'Battle' on [[Insignificant Rebellion]] is treated as 'battle or duel. (Immune to [[Alter]]).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Join Us Or Die]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-04-Join_Us_Or_Die-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-joinusordie-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Join_Us_Or_Die.png]]) show the original text (see [[Join Us Or Die]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Join Us Or Die]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on your Throne Room. While Emperor and Vader here, Take Your Father's Place does not deplete Life Force or cause Force loss. Once per turn, may ▼ So Be It, Jedi or a docking bay. "Battle" on Insignificant Rebellion is treated as "battle or duel." [Immune to Alter]” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-joinusordie-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Join_Us_Or_Die.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 28) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▼ out and swapped the two targets (“deploy a docking bay or So Be It, Jedi from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), and printed the closing quote mark wrongly (“'battle or duel.”, as published)<ref name="cl-1281_11-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on your Throne Room. While Emperor and Vader here, Take Your Father's Place does not deplete Life Force or cause Force loss. Once per turn, may deploy a docking bay or So Be It, Jedi from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. 'Battle' on Insignificant Rebellion is treated as 'battle or duel. (Immune to Alter).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-04-Join_Us_Or_Die-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
